messages:
Maya: Quick beta check-in for the 'Preview: Dedicated Cache' cohort — enrollment status + feedback loop planning. Customers: Beacon Health, RedLeaf, NovaRetail. Beacon still pending legal, RedLeaf onboarded, Nova reported latency spikes. Who can help with triage and scheduling feedback calls this week?

Jordan: Beacon update: legal asked for a SOC2 addendum; expecting sign by next Wed. I can chase.

Anita: Thanks. For NovaRetail latency — @Tom can you look at model routing logs? They saw 300-600ms p99 for embeddings, which is higher than the baseline.

Tom: On it. Quick dashboard query I run: `env=preview cohort=dedicated-cache | p99(latency_tokens)` — I'll dig into the traces and KV cache behavior. ETA EOD.

Maya: Great. For feedback loops: propose 30-min calls with each customer, capture notes in the beta feedback doc and send a short survey after the call. Draft survey here: https://tiny.redwood/surveys/preview1 (feel free to edit).

Jordan: I'll schedule Beacon + RedLeaf. Nova prefers Wed afternoon — I have them at 3:30pm.

Anita: Also capture renewal risk in the notes: Beacon legal delay -> medium risk until signed. RedLeaf is generally happy but asked about SSO and rollout timeline -> low-medium.

Tom: Found a hotspot: KV cache eviction thrashing on long-prefix ops for NovaRetail. Quick mitigation is to increase cache TTL from 60s -> 300s and tune eviction policy. Pushing canary now: `preview-cache-canary-3`. Will post metrics.

OnboardBot: Reminder: onboarding checklist updated: docs sent -> yes; initial runbook -> yes; performance baseline recorded -> no.

Maya: Thanks @OnboardBot. Action items: Jordan chase Beacon legal (due 3/20), Tom confirm canary results + roll to cohort if stable, Anita update survey with an SSO question, I'll draft feedback call agenda and share. Anyone object to a weekly sync for this preview cohort on Fridays?

Jordan: :thumbsup: fine for me.

Anita: Works for me.

Tom: Works. I'll post canary metrics in this thread when available.

Maya: Adding meeting invites now and will update thread with outcomes. Thanks team :rocket:
